title: Pressure tanks.
officialText:
Tank systems containing water and air in combination under pressure exceeding 15 psi (103.4 kPa) above
atmospheric pressure, where the pressure is supplied and maintained by pumps connected directly to the tanks, shall comply with the
requirements of this section.
